hypotheses.reasoning: order-service heap climbs steadily after full GC (78%→84%→90%, GC overhead 20→50%), meaning old gen is not being freed. That ends in OutOfMemoryError at orderCache.put, and order-service-2 gets OOMKilled at the 2Gi limit again and again (restarts 1–3). Each crash or restart lines up with a burst of gateway 502s ('connection reset, no healthy upstream'). The cause looks like an unbounded in-memory orderCache. No deploy appears in the window, payment, postgres and redis show no errors, and the TLS cert warning is unrelated.
v4.15.0 may have added the unbounded cache, but no deploy event appears in the window.

verdict.recommendedAction: Short term: raise the order-service memory limit or scale out replicas to stop the crash loop, and take a heap dump before the next OOM. Fix: put a size cap and eviction (LRU/TTL) on orderCache, and check whether the cache leak came with v4.15.0; if so, roll back. Add alerts on heap usage after GC.
